text:
Marta (partnerships): Quick kickoff — Bridge Labs micro-summit next Wed 10:00-12:00 PT. We’re co-hosting a 30m keynote, two 20m partner-enabled demos, and a remote hands-on lab. Need signoffs: speakers, demo runbooks, and last-mile swag.
Luis (events): I have the venue flow. Can we confirm speakers today? I need names for badges and AV. :calendar:
Jin Park (Bridge Labs): Jin here — Bridge Labs will send Alex (PM) and Priya (ML engineer) to do the 20m demo. They want 10 mins of Q&A.
Marta (partnerships): Great — Redwood speaker is Sasha for the keynote, Tom will pair with Priya on the model-serving demo. That leaves the 2nd demo slot open. Ideas?
Sasha (devex): I can broaden the keynote to include the Marketplace announcement if legal gives greenlight. Need the one-slide blurb by EOD Tue.
Tom (eng-runtime): For the model-serving demo we need a dedicated 2xA100 instance for a 15m live run, and a cached fallback video if infra is flaky. Who owns the fallback clip?
Jin Park (Bridge Labs): We can record a ~6m fallback clip. Bridge Labs will produce it, but need a short script from Redwood for the integration callouts.
Harpreet (logistics): Swag update — we have 80 partner kits (stickers, card, 1x branded power bank). Shipping cutoff Fri 11:59pm. Who provides a packing list?
Marta (partnerships): I’ll draft packing list. Can someone confirm we can include an SSD with preloaded demo VM? Legal/security?
Sasha (devex): SSD with VM is a no-go from security. We can do a USB thumbdrive with an index.html that points to an auth-gated cloud sandbox instead. Less risky.
Tom (eng-runtime): Agreed. We’ll provide ephemeral demo accounts + container image (pull from registry). Runbook snippet for eng-oncall: ```1) Start sandbox infra: ./start-demo --region us-west2 2) Confirm model v=redwood-2026.03 3) Run load-test script: ./demo/load.sh```
Luis (events): AV notes: please send slide deck PDFs and the 16:9 keynote speaker bio by Tue 09:00 PT. Also we need mic check at 09:15 on event day.
Jin Park (Bridge Labs): Who’s the day-of Slack contact? Also can we get an SNOW ticket number for racks?
Marta (partnerships): Day-of contact: Luis. SNOW ticket — Harpreet, can you open it?
Harpreet (logistics): Opening now. Ticket #SNOW-4427. I’ll add shipping manifest attachment when labels are printed.
calendar-bot: Event slot reserved: Bridge Labs micro-summit — 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. Invite updated with Zoom link and runbook doc.
Sasha (devex): Action items I have: keynote slide blurb (EOD Tue), devdocs for partner sandbox (Mon), speaker checklist.
Tom (eng-runtime): I’ll build the container image and upload to registry by Tue 17:00 PT. Will add fallback video to shared drive.
Jin Park (Bridge Labs): We’ll send speaker bios + fallback clip draft by Mon noon.
Harpreet (logistics): Shipping list draft attached in drive. I’ll add courier pick-up times once we finalize address.
Marta (partnerships): Thanks all — small follow-up: please add any runbook ops commands to the runbook doc in the calendar invite so oncall can copy/paste. If anything blocks, ping me. :thumbsup:
Luis (events): noted. I’ll post final run-of-show by Tue evening.
Jin Park (Bridge Labs): Excited — see you all on the run-through.
Sasha (devex): Rehearsal Thursday 11:00 PT? Works for Redwood.
Marta (partnerships): Rehearsal scheduled. End thread.
